title: Contact and Debt
premise: Ivo Marchetti, a disgraced intelligence analyst living off unattributable freelance work, is approached by a stranger claiming Ivo once saved her life—a favor Ivo has no memory of performing. The debt comes due: she needs his skills to identify and stop a staged 'accident' at a border checkpoint before the night shift changes, an attack designed to ignite a regional conflict. As Ivo digs in, they discover the stranger's identity is fabricated and the favor was engineered to recruit them, forcing a choice between exposing the conspiracy through legal channels that will bury it, or acting outside the law. In the end, Ivo stops the attack at the checkpoint but lets the stranger vanish with the proof, choosing loyalty to one person over the truth for everyone—and finally understanding why their own past was erased.
about_author: Juniper Lockridge is the pen name of a former policy researcher who spent years writing about border infrastructure before turning to fiction. They live near a major crossing point and write at night, when the trucks stop moving.

chapters.title: The Favor That Never Happened
chapters.summary: Ivo Marchetti's POV. A woman named Sera Voss appears at Ivo's cramped apartment, thanking them for saving her life in Sarajevo—an event Ivo cannot recall and records contradict. She leaves a burner phone and a warning: the debt is real whether Ivo remembers it or not. Emotional beat: unease; Ivo's carefully invisible life has been seen through.

chapters.title: Interest Owed
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Unable to resist verifying, Ivo pulls old files and finds a gap—three days missing from their own service record, scrubbed too cleanly to be accidental. Sera calls: she needs help identifying cargo moving through the Kellner Pass checkpoint. Emotional beat: reluctant curiosity curdling into compulsion as Ivo realizes someone rewrote their past.

chapters.title: Ghost Manifest
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Freight manifests show a shipment scheduled to pass Kellner Pass during the shift change window, flagged with paperwork so perfect it's artificial. Cross-referencing reveals the same logistics shell company touched three prior 'accidents.' Emotional beat: cold dread—the pattern is professional, and Ivo recognizes the tradecraft as agency-grade.

chapters.title: Sera, Unbound
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. We learn who Sera claims to be—and the cracks in it. She meets a handler who reminds her the recruitment of Marchetti must look organic, and that the deadline is fixed: the attack happens when the night shift rotates in nine days. Emotional beat: guilt; Sera is using a man she's come to respect as bait.

chapters.title: Three Agencies, No Home
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo visits a former colleague, Dane Okafor, trading favors for access to personnel archives. The missing three days connect to a black program called LANTERN that laundered operatives' identities—including, possibly, Ivo's own. Emotional beat: grief and anger; Ivo's burnout wasn't failure, it was design.

chapters.title: Checkpoint Arithmetic
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Field reconnaissance at Kellner Pass: Ivo maps sightlines, shift rosters, and where a truck bomb disguised as a fuel tanker would do maximum casualties while reading as an accident. Sera insists they can't go to authorities—the leak is inside them. Emotional beat: mounting pressure as Ivo realizes the clock, not the enemy, is the real adversary.

chapters.title: The Leak Inside
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. Sera discovers her own handler is feeding the attackers the checkpoint schedule—the operation she's running is meant to fail loudly, discrediting oversight reform. She must decide whether to tell Ivo the recruitment was manufactured. Emotional beat: self-loathing tipping toward defiance; she chooses Ivo over the program.

chapters.title: Confession at the Motel
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Sera confesses everything: there was no favor, no Sarajevo rescue—only a dossier proving Ivo once refused an illegal order, making them the only analyst LANTERN's architects couldn't control. Ivo walks out into the rain. Emotional beat: betrayal and its strange twin, relief—Ivo's erased past finally makes sense.

chapters.title: Shift Change
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV, climax. With eight hours left, Ivo and Sera go outside the law: spoofing the logistics system to reroute the tanker into a customs inspection bay, then physically triggering the checkpoint lockdown as the truck arrives early. The bomb detonates in the empty inspection lane. Emotional beat: white-knuckle terror resolving into hard-won triumph—at cost of exposing themselves to both sides.

chapters.title: Debt Forgiven
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV, resolution. Officially, a fuel fire; unofficially, Ivo holds the LANTERN ledger. Authorities close in on Sera, but Ivo gives her the ledger copy and a head start—loyalty over justice, this once. Weeks later, a postcard arrives: no words, just a date and place. The favor, finally real. Emotional beat: quiet, complicated peace; Ivo is visible now, and chooses it.
